[New]

📚 **Documentation updated**: The MyParcel GitBook (Dutch and English) now has a page for **every carrier** with countries, how to connect, settings, all capabilities, **Flow cards and tokens**, plus updated widget, Flow example and troubleshooting pages.

🛍️ **Vinted Go everywhere**: The device and all its Flow cards are now called **Vinted Go** instead of Homerr. Your existing devices and Flows keep working.

🏪 **New App Store description**: The description lists all **19 carriers** and is available in **13 languages**.

[Fix]

🏷️ **Right carrier in Flow tokens**: On every carrier except GLS, the Flow tokens were called **“GLS status text”**, **“Previous GLS status text”** and **“ParcelShop”**. They now show the **right carrier name** and a general **pickup point** title (DPD and GLS keep ParcelShop).

❓ **“Unknown” status**: The **“a parcel has status…”** condition showed **“Not yet known at GLS”** for every carrier; it now names the right carrier.

[Improvement]

📍 **Clearer pickup titles**: Pickup point capabilities of Budbee, DHL, Post & DHL Germany, FedEx, Vinted Go, InPost and bpost use one clear name in every language.

🌟 Enjoy the improved MyParcel v0.3.7 App with the right carrier names in every Flow and fully updated documentation.
